name: Dutasteride
description: Synthetic 4-azasteroid that blocks type 1 and type 2 5α-reductase, taken by mouth

note.lead: Hair loss is off-label in the US.
note.text: Japan approved it for male pattern hair loss in 2015. US hair-loss use is off-label.

bullets: **Inhibits conversion** of testosterone to DHT, per the label
**Blocks both isoforms;** type 1 is also active in skin and liver
**Blood DHT** fell by a median 90% after 2 weeks at 0.5 mg a day
**Testosterone** rose by about 19%, staying in the normal range
Hair: 3 Phase 3 trials, 24 weeks to 6 months
Largest hair trial: 917 men vs finasteride

practical.halfLife: About 5 weeks; detectable 4 to 6 months after stopping
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in 2 to 3 hours; liver metabolism (CYP3A4, CYP3A5)

regulatory.text: Approved for BPH (2001); hair loss is off-label
Approved for male pattern hair loss (2015)

references: Gubelin Harcha et al., J Am Acad Dermatol, dutasteride vs finasteride, Mar 2014
